title.en: EU DPP Textile Ontology - Textile Substances of Concern Module

description.en: Textile-sector specialisation of the EU DPP Substances of Concern ontology. It specialises substance presence, product location, concentration reporting, product-group qualification, thresholds and lifecycle handling for textile products.

comments.en: This module does not classify every textile chemical as a substance of concern. It specialises the generic SoC presence-context model for textile products and attaches textile-specific information to the occurrence, not globally to the chemical identity.
